author: Leon Made This / s010s

name.zh: Phragmoceras · SM75 缺损正模壳标本

description.en: Evidence-informed stylized depiction of the damaged SM 75 holotype. Missing apex and incomplete hyponomic margin retained. Aperture depth, hidden surfaces and limestone palette are original conservative interpretations, not measured restoration. Historical 43/33 mm measurements have undefined axes; this model is not a direct calibrated restoration of those measurements. Neither a complete deep hyponomic tube nor a living animal is reconstructed.
description.zh: 依原文制作的 SM 75 缺损壳标本风格化表现；不补顶端及完整漏斗口。口腔深度、隐藏面及色彩属于明确标注的保守推定。 文献中的43/33毫米量值轴向未明，模型尺寸不等同于这些量值的直接复原。 不复原完整深漏斗管或活体动物。

scientific_scope_departure: Original provisional curved inflated shell with strongly constricted slit-like aperture target is narrowed to damaged SM75. A complete apex, deep complete hyponomic tube and entire terminal aperture are not restored. Preserved U and damage margins are stylized, not source-measured contours.

reference_credits.title: Manda (2007), New Silurian nautiloids Phragmoceras and Tubiferoceras from the Prague Basin
reference_credits.use: consulted-only; no reference media, mesh or texture incorporated
